groups.title: Comparison domain and similarity
groups.proposal: Build similarity from exact typed NNC, VNC, pronominal, or composition Results through licensed routes.
groups.readingJob: Show typed Sources, similarity route, operation, AST, formula, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: The route and genuine continuation choices are selectable; Source identity is owner-issued.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not authorize comparison from lesson, evidence, formula, surface, or copied Result.

groups.title: Equality comparison
groups.proposal: Compose equality through licensed iuhqui and related typed routes.
groups.readingJob: Show comparand, standard, equality route, markers, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Equality route is a choice only where both captured Sources license it.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not equate Sources from translation alone.

groups.title: Size comparison
groups.proposal: Compose size relations from exact typed Sources and licensed size strategies.
groups.readingJob: Show size route, comparand, standard, degree, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Strategy is selectable; lexical class and Source facts are derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not infer size grammar from an adjective gloss.

groups.title: Comparative degree
groups.proposal: Compose comparative degree, including panahuia profiles, with exact object specificity and point-of-comparison Sources.
groups.readingJob: Show route, object specificity, point, adjunctor, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Licensed route and adjunctor are choices; object specificity remains canonical.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not override object specificity from a displayed form.

groups.title: How-much-more questions
groups.proposal: Compose degree questions through exact base and degree clauses plus licensed interrogative collocations.
groups.readingJob: Show base clause, degree clause, question collocation, order, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Only inventory-backed question collocations are choices.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not accept a stored Canvas phrase as a marker.

groups.title: Ordinary superlatives
groups.proposal: Compose ordinary superlatives from typed topic and predicate Results plus licensed adverbials.
groups.readingJob: Show topic, predicate, superlative adverbial, sentence type, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Adverbial and sentence type are choices where licensed.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not authorize superlative degree from English translation.

groups.title: Honorific superlatives
groups.proposal: Preserve honorific predicate identity while composing the superlative through the same canonical comparison path.
groups.readingJob: Show exact honorific Source, superlative profile, sentence projection, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Superlative choices never reconstruct or invent honorific morphology.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not infer honorific status from surface spelling.
